description: PORTOS DO ESTADO DE ALAGOAS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Independente de qualquer outra aplicação secundária, este conjunto de dados destina-se ao USO como dado fundamental de referências. Fornece o conjunto de dados das categorias previstas na EDGV. Limitado ao enquadramento previsto no índice de nomenclatura. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Alagoas, Portos. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
